correctness.rationale: Exact direct proof: zero total balance has a move to empty, nonzero total balance admits a move-preserving two-boundary reduction; the interior Dyck criterion follows by induction. Interior passage weights are entries of the tridiagonal finite-path resolvent with continuant determinant, while Narayana peak counts give the total series. The nonregular slice is proved by direct itineraries and the pumping lemma. Exact-power-series and independent game verification replay for all lengths through 16, with further coefficients through 18; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: An exact count at every length of the losing positions in a natural two-sided, nonregular word-subtraction game gives a global invariant beyond recognizing individual positions. Variable-height first-passage decomposition and peak-refined Catalan combinatorics provide a reusable counting method; the regular-slice obstruction reveals genuinely infinite-state behavior. The result is mathematically motivated by a recently published two-sided word game framework, with no claim of a general nimber law or a better-than-coefficientwise asymptotic.
